summary: D10 reviewed the 27 medicine nodes (5 trunk, 22 subtree). Kept 18 (one with a corrected emerged date), split 1 (anatomy_dissection -> physiology) and rebalanced 8: four prerequisite repairs with unchanged cost (blood_transfusion, hormonal_contraception, monoclonal_antibodies, ivf), and four re-scores (antibiotic_resistance and chemotherapy by the prerequisite convention; chemotherapy, medical_imaging and antiviral_drugs by material). Five new nodes: physiology (A7), epidemiology (A8), immunology, endocrinology and sulfonamides (A9). They add the missing public-health pillar, separate three sciences (physiology, immunology, endocrinology) from the applications that used them as proxies, repair three non-causal edges (genetics -> contraception, anaesthesia -> transfusion, germ theory -> chemotherapy), and add a genuine alternative route to antibacterial therapy. The research-stage atom medicine_hippocratic, both Age facts (germ_theory, antibiotic_penicillin), the D-047-ruled edges and the pinned oral_rehydration cost are unchanged. Every dead end now has an owner: most enter the M9 disease model (SIR on the trade network) through named channels (transmission, susceptibility, case fatality, cohort mortality, fertility, Health need); surgery_instruments' military hospital is M7; trepanation stays knowledge-only by explicit justification. Workload: new nodes +135,410 RP; re-scores +48,750 RP.
